main.description: An owner renames a context, opens it to the public or closes it, or locks it against direct additions. An absent field stays as it is. A rename keeps the address: the slug is what links point at. `public` opens the context and what is in it to everyone, signed in or not.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not an owner of the context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An empty name, or a visibility that is neither.
